_comment: Pinned MMIO bring-up trace our own BCO first stage must produce (ADR 0031).
Ordered list of [address, value] writes to the clock block (0xe0007000), the SDRAM
controller (0xe001d000) and 0x70000000. These register values are hardware facts read
from the stock first stage (App_BD 9423); the code that writes them is ours.
check-first-init.py models the ST20's delay-line measurement (0xe0007844: 0xa00d0f07,
then 0x800d0703, read on hardware 2026-10-16) and the self-clearing SDRAM command bits,
and asserts our built first.bin produces exactly this (with --stock, a local copy only,
that the stock first stage does too). Clock: 24 MHz crystal -> PLL 480 MHz, AHB 80 MHz.
